text:
marta: Heads-up: Cerulean Data sent INV-2026-0724 and it's flagged. Looks like the invoice uses an old PO and includes a new bank account in the same PDF.

diego: Can you paste the PO that appears on the invoice so I can attempt auto-match?

marta: Invoice PO = CER-2019-555. Our canonical PO after consolidation is CER-2026-332.

hana: From vendor: they consolidated two payment entities and AP accidentally reissued with the legacy PO. Correct PO should be CER-2026-332. They also changed the receiving account. Uploaded docs incoming.

```
LegacyAcct: CER-OLD-88
NewAcct: CER-PAY-440 (effective 2026-04-20)
```

li: Any bank change triggers KYC/KBA. Procurement confirmation required to remap PO. I'm remote until EOD.

approvals-bot: Hold created: reasons=[PO_MISMATCH,BANK_UPDATE]; required_actions=[attach_po_amendment, vendor_bank_proof, procurement_confirm_or_finance_2up].

diego: Two choices: wait for procurement to reconcile or Finance can do a temporary two-person signoff to release this run. Is vendor pressing for payment?

hana: Vendor flagged possible 1.5% late fee after 6 days. They uploaded a signed PO amendment and bank ownership proof: https://files.cerulean.example/INV-2026-0724-amend.pdf

marta: Please confirm amendment includes both PO numbers and the vendor tax ID. I'll need to post audit note with GL/cost center for treasury.

hana: Amendment includes TAX ID, both POs, and AP contact. Bank doc includes proof of account ownership.

diego: Marta, post GL + cost_center and I can request treasury manual override. Need 2 approvers (you + Li or Platform).

marta: GL=5408-infra; cost_center=platform-compute-prod. Audit note: "Temporary finance release pending procurement reconciliation; vendor amendment and bank proof attached."

li: I can't approve from procurement remotely, but I will open a ticket to reconcile PO mapping when I return.

approvals-bot: Documents uploaded. Pending steps: [treasury_manual_override_request, procurement_reconcile_ticket].

diego: Submitted manual override to Treasury with "Cerulean consolidation - temp finance 2-up; docs attached." ETA 24-48h, flagged high due to late fee.

marta: If Treasury rejects, escalate to Finance Lead for emergency approval. I'll monitor and update.

hana: Vendor asked to be notified once payment is initiated.

diego: Summary: amendment + bank proof attached; GL set; manual override requested; approvals-bot hold remains until procurement reconciles or treasury approves.

marta: Thanks everyone :pray:
_meta: Slack thread export: vendor consolidation produced PO mismatch + bank update; includes root message + replies in chronological order
